name: Media Monitor
description: Read-only social media monitoring via an external MediaCrawler-compatible sidecar. Not for auto-posting.

adapterCommand.description: External adapter argv prefix, e.g. ["python3","-m","openbot_media_adapter"]. Never shell-concatenated.

adapterCwd.description: Working directory for the sidecar process (must stay under gateway cwd when relative).

defaultPlatform.description: MVP supports xhs only; adapter interface remains extensible.

tickIntervalMs.description: Internal due-check interval (not a user-facing APScheduler).

notifyChannel.description: Existing OpenBot channel id for notifications (e.g. telegram).

notifyTo.description: Destination for notifications on the selected channel.

cookieSecret.description: SecretRef or string for cookie material passed to the sidecar via env OPENBOT_MEDIA_COOKIE (never logged).

adapterCommand.label: Adapter command
adapterCommand.help: External bounded process only. Do not vendor MediaCrawler into OpenBot.
